title: Auto-Heal Your API Channels with Sub2API Guardian
description:
Sub2API Guardian is a channel scheduling guardian service for sub2api. It automates health and latency testing to drive circuit breaking, downgrading, and weight adjustment.

This single-binary tool features an embedded frontend, zero external dependencies, and a fail-safe mechanism ensuring every group has at least one active channel at any moment.
